scope: Read-only official catalogs/documentation and canonical public chain observations; no source/docs edit, deployment, price update, signer, transaction, service/site or existing fork/journal changes.

redstone_pull.scope: Asset coverage map, not proof of a deployed chain4663 AggregatorV3 feed.

catalog_coverage.absence_limit: No match in these retrieved public catalogs is not proof that no private/custom product exists. A ticker alone would not authenticate the fixed ZZZ token.

failure_reasons: Pyth ETH stored observation is older than the hard one-day age ceiling.
Observed Chainlink/Pyth answers disagree by more than the selected3% even if stale data were improperly used.
Both listed Chainlink proxies resolve the exact SAME aggregator and owner; phase-prefixed round IDs do not establish independence.
No fixed-ZZZ on-chain USD source, let alone two independently reviewed sources, identified in these catalogs.

capability_map.chainlink_push: Actual decimals/latestRoundData shape matches Oracle source ABI; current source runtime/round observed, owner/aggregator policies still require independent qualification.
capability_map.pyth_core: Existing optional ZZZPythPriceFeed accepts Core getPriceUnsafe feedID/exponent/age/confidence through a separately deployed reviewed immutable reader. It never pushes updates or funds them. No reader deployment authorized/performed.
capability_map.pyth_pro: Officially listed Robinhood0xACeA761c27A909d4D3895128EBe6370FDE2dF481 verifies signed per-transaction payloads and stores no price; not a direct replacement for the current Core adapter.
capability_map.redstone_pull: Signed data appended to a consumer transaction is not consumed by the current Oracle static decimals/latestRoundData calls. Needs a separately reviewed compatible stored-price adapter/updater or architecture change; no such correct-chain address was identified.
capability_map.dex_price: Instantaneous target/deeper pool prices are not independent ZZZ/USD feeds. Multiple wrappers or windows over one thin market do not establish source independence.

upstream_and_operations.proxy_pin_limit: A177-byte proxy runtime pin does not freeze the implementation. Zero owner/admin slot does not establish immutability; actual governanceDataSource remains populated.
upstream_and_operations.sequencer_notice: Chainlink official supported list omits Robinhood and states expansion to new networks has ended. Robinhood docs provide a generic uptime-check example but no deployable correct-chain address. Do not substitute Arbitrum One or fabricate a permanently-up source.
upstream_and_operations.observed_provider_limit: Initial upstream metadata read receivedHTTP429; bounded later fixed-anchor retry and final header recheck succeeded. These public endpoints are explicitly rate-limited/not recommended for production.
upstream_and_operations.verified_source_access: Blockscout source API returned403 for both observed implementations. Contract existence/runtime is observed; verified-source/admin review remains incomplete.

required_external_inputs: Two source proposals authenticated to this exact fixed ZZZ asset, with independent upstream markets/reporters and administration review.
A sustainable authenticated Pyth update service or another actual correct-chain ETH/USD source, with measured age, cost and outages.
Reviewed ETH/ZZZ provider/common-market/proxy/governance policies and operational maximum ages, not merely distinct labels.
A correct-chain sequencer-liveness policy/source decision and post-outage recovery rationale.
